title: Pattern document (v1.1.0): architecture pattern or reference architecture
description: One of the two kinds of pattern document the continuum names, authored by the pattern skill: an architecture pattern (AP-NNN, technology-agnostic, conceptual or logical, its boxes local roles or ABBs) or a reference architecture (RA-NNN, technology-specific, physical, its boxes SBBs and technologies, applying one or more architecture patterns). The type is declared as pattern_type and must agree with the identifier's series.

pattern_type.description: architecture-pattern: technology-agnostic, series AP. reference-architecture: technology-specific, series RA, applies architecture patterns.

pattern_scope.description: The scope the document answers, from one recurring problem to a whole platform or epic.

implements.description: The architecture patterns this reference architecture applies. Required on a reference architecture.

implemented_by.description: The reference architectures that apply this architecture pattern.

realises.description: The capabilities the document is evidence for, read by aaa-rung.

flows.description: The capability flows the document is scoped to; none means all of them.

serves.description: The use cases whose scenarios this document's scenarios walk.

diagram.description: The draw.io diagram the model skill keeps in step with the document's tables, relative to the document.

allOf.$comment: The series says the type: an architecture pattern is AP-NNN.
A reference architecture is RA-NNN and applies at least one architecture pattern.
